title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids for Prevention of Post-Operative Atrial Fibrillation

sections.abstract:
This is a large multi-center study to examine whether peri-operative intake of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA) will reduce the occurrence of post-operative atrial fibrillation or flutter (AF) in patients undergoing cardiac surgery (CS).

Posted outcomes: Any First Post-op Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter (AF). timeframe=up to 10 days post-surgery or discharge, whichever sooner. Olive Oil Capsule=233; Omega-3 Fatty Acid Capsules=227
